♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in mid-Cancer shifting from Pushya into Ashlesha and Mars already strong there, your 4th house of inner security and home is on fire from within. The Libra Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus all sit in your 7th house, turning the mirror of relationships directly toward you. Jupiter just into early Leo in your 5th adds a bold, playful undercurrent, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces continues its quiet restructuring in your 12th. It’s an emotionally charged but potentially deeply clarifying day about where you really belong—and with whom.

💼 Career: Work outcomes today are tied less to public performance and more to how settled you feel in your base of operations. The Moon–Mars mix in your 4th can make you want to rearrange everything—desk, schedule, even living situation—to create more breathing room. Use that urge to simplify your environment so you can think clearly. The Libra cluster in your 7th favors serious conversations with clients, collaborators or business partners, especially about expectations and timelines. Because both Venus and Mercury are retrograde, this is better for rebalancing an existing arrangement than launching something brand new. Jupiter in your 5th encourages creative risks and leadership in projects—share one bolder idea instead of trying to overhaul everything at once.

❤️ Love: Relationship themes are unmistakable today. The 7th-house stellium puts partners, exes and even close friends into focus as teachers. Old dynamics may replay, not to trap you, but to show you what you’re finally done tolerating. With the Moon and Mars stirring your 4th, you’ll feel protective of your emotional space and may react strongly if anyone criticizes your family, home or deepest habits. If partnered, consciously shift from “who is right” to “what feels safe for both of us.” If single, you may notice a pull toward someone who feels familiar; pause long enough to ask whether that familiarity comes from comfort or from an old pattern you’re ready to outgrow.

💰 Money: Jupiter lighting up your 5th tends to widen your appetite for enjoyment—children, hobbies, creative ventures, speculative investments. Today the Cancer focus connects that impulse to home and family: expenses around housing, decor, moves, or family needs may come up. Be generous where it truly supports emotional stability, not just to soothe a mood. With the Libra 7th active, shared financial arrangements, fee splits and promises around money with others deserve review. Retrograde Venus is ideal for re-negotiating terms so they feel fair on both sides, especially if you’ve been carrying more than your share.

🧘 Advice: When you feel that surge of “I have to fix this house/life/relationship right now,” break it into one specific, doable adjustment—and complete that before deciding on the next.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The partnerships that really belong to you don’t fear your fire— they get steadier when your roots are honest.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon travels through Cancer in late Pushya and into Ashlesha, joining Mars in your 3rd house of communication, siblings and short journeys. Your ruler Venus is retrograde in Libra with the Sun and retrograde Mercury, emphasizing your 6th house of routines, work and health. Jupiter freshly in Leo lights up your 4th, expanding home and emotional foundations, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces works slowly through your 11th, adjusting your long-term aspirations and social networks. Your mind is busy, but the real story lies in how you manage your daily life.

💼 Career: It’s a day of calls, messages and quick pivots. The Moon–Mars combo in the 3rd can make you unusually direct—sometimes blunt—so be mindful of tone in emails and chats. Use that sharpness to cut through confusion, not to win every minor argument. The Libra stellium in your 6th favors editing workflows, redefining responsibilities and renegotiating deliverables. Because both Venus and Mercury are retrograde, you’re in a powerful window to fix inefficient systems, revisit job descriptions or revive a useful habit that once kept you grounded. Jupiter in your 4th suggests that investing effort in your home office or base of operations—better lighting, ergonomics, or boundaries around work hours—pays off in sustained productivity.

❤️ Love: Romance today is woven into the fabric of everyday life. The 6th-house Libra stellium emphasizes kindness in small actions: how you speak when you’re tired, whether you notice your partner’s stress, and how willing you are to share practical burdens. With Moon and Mars in your 3rd, conversations may flip quickly from light to heated; practice catching yourself before sarcasm lands as criticism. If partnered, focus on one or two concrete improvements to your shared routine rather than dissecting the entire relationship. If single, attraction could arise through neighbors, colleagues or online exchanges; look for someone whose consistency matches your need for steadiness, not just someone who chats charmingly.

💰 Money: Your financial picture is anchored in the small choices you repeat every day. The Libra 6th emphasis favors reconsidering subscriptions, service costs, commuting expenses and food habits. Retrograde Venus is perfect for cancelling what you don’t use and negotiating better terms where you’ve been too passive. Moon–Mars in the 3rd can correlate with impulse purchases during errands or online scrolling; slow down before clicking “buy,” especially for gadgets and courses. Jupiter in the 4th may increase spending or opportunity around property, relocation or family projects—prioritize what truly enriches your sense of home.

🧘 Advice: When your mind starts multitasking conversations, errands and worries, pause and pick one interaction where you will be fully present and kind from start to finish.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The stability you’re building isn’t hiding in one huge breakthrough—it’s quietly forming inside the choices you repeat without thinking.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon moving through Cancer’s Pushya–Ashlesha zone joins Mars in your 2nd house of income, speech and self-worth. Your ruler Mercury is retrograde in Libra alongside the Sun and retrograde Venus in your 5th house, spotlighting creativity, children, pleasure and romance. Jupiter at the very start of Leo activates your 3rd, feeding curiosity and movement, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces continues its sober work in your 10th house of career and public standing. You’re poised between wanting to play and needing to get serious about what you’re building.

💼 Career: Money and recognition are intertwined today. The Moon–Mars pairing in your 2nd gives you courage to discuss pay, pricing or the value of your skills, but it also heightens sensitivity to any hint of being undervalued. Take a breath before responding to feedback—clarity beats defensiveness. The Libra 5th-house stellium emphasizes revisiting creative projects, presentations or brand elements; it’s a strong day for editing, re-styling or reviving an old idea whose time might finally be right. Saturn in your 10th keeps reminding you to measure every shiny opportunity against long-term credibility: does this align with the expertise and reputation you want five years from now?

❤️ Love: The 5th-house activation makes your romantic life more vivid, but the retrogrades give it a reflective tilt. Past crushes, earlier stages of current relationships, or old creative passions may resurface in memory or on your screen. This isn’t necessarily a signal to go back; it’s a chance to see what kind of attention truly nourishes you. With Moon and Mars in the 2nd, words land heavily—compliments can feel intoxicating, while criticism may sting more than usual. If partnered, show affection by recognizing each other’s talents and contributions out loud. If single, enjoy flirtation but pay attention to whether potential partners respect your time, not just your wit.

💰 Money: The 2nd house is highly charged, making this an important day for practical choices. You may feel pushed to secure your position—pay off something, demand fairness, or protect savings. That drive is useful if you direct it into concrete steps like updating a budget or renegotiating a single contract instead of catastrophizing. Jupiter in the 3rd can tempt you toward spending on learning, travel or tech; choose what genuinely enhances your skills or freedom. The Libra 5th-house emphasis suggests reviewing how much you invest in hobbies, dating or children; refine the balance between joy and sustainability.

🧘 Advice: Each time you’re about to say “it doesn’t matter” about money or recognition, check whether that’s true—or whether something important in you is asking to be taken seriously.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your voice gains real power the moment you treat your own talents as resources worth protecting, not as favors you hand out for free.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

Across the sky, the Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra emphasize your 4th house of home, family and emotional roots. Jupiter newly in Leo lights up your 2nd house of resources and values, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces continues its reality-check work in your 9th, testing your beliefs, education and long-term plans. You’re standing at a threshold between who you’ve been at home and who you’re becoming in the world.

💼 Career: With the Moon and Mars in your 1st, your presence is unmistakable—people notice your mood, your stance, your yes and your no. This can be excellent for initiating conversations, asserting boundaries and taking leadership on something that has floated without direction. Just watch the tendency to react before you’ve heard all the information. The Libra 4th-house stellium points to behind-the-scenes changes: moving, renovating, renegotiating family expectations around your work, or simply rethinking what “success” feels like from the inside. Jupiter in your 2nd encourages you to think bigger about earnings or business models, but Saturn in the 9th asks you to ground ambitions in skills and ethics, not just emotion.

❤️ Love: Emotions are running hot and close to the surface. The Moon–Mars combo in your sign can bring passionate affection, protective instincts and, if triggered, sharp defensiveness. The Libra activation in your 4th house suggests that relationship themes are deeply entangled with home life: who feels welcome, how domestic tasks are divided, how safe it is to be vulnerable. If partnered, today is better suited for calmly reworking a shared living pattern than for sweeping declarations. If single, you might feel a pull toward people who seem to understand your history; let Saturn in your 9th remind you to notice whether your future paths are compatible, not just your past wounds.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 2nd can be a blessing for income and resourcefulness over the coming months, but it also expands whatever attitude you hold about money. Today, with your own sign strongly activated, you may swing between “I must save everything” and “I deserve to splurge.” Aim for grounded generosity: one meaningful expenditure on security or nourishment, paired with one concrete step toward long-term stability. The Libra 4th-house focus can bring talks about rent, mortgages, family support or shared expenses at home. Retrogrades support adjusting old agreements into something more balanced.

🧘 Advice: When a wave of feeling rises, resist the urge to immediately change everything around you. First, name the emotion clearly; then choose a single, kind action that honors it.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your real strength today isn’t in how fiercely you protect your shell, but in how honestly you let it reshape around who you are now.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through Cancer in Pushya and into Ashlesha in your 12th house of rest, subconscious and endings, joining Mars already stirring your hidden landscape. Your Sun ruler is in Libra with retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in your 3rd house, highlighting thought patterns, neighbors, siblings and communication habits. Jupiter newly in your own sign opens a long window of growth and renewed confidence, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces continues deep work in your 8th house of shared resources and psychological depth. On the surface you may seem composed, but an inner script is clearly being rewritten.

💼 Career: Outwardly, this may look like a normal workday; inwardly, you’re re-organizing the back office of your mind. The 12th-house Moon–Mars combo favors research, strategy and closing out loose ends rather than big public moves. You may feel a strong urge to work alone or withdraw from noisy environments—honor that where you can. The Libra 3rd-house stellium emphasizes editing documents, revising proposals and rethinking how you talk about your work. Retrograde Mercury is excellent for finding better language for what you already do, or for reconnecting with a contact from the past. Jupiter in your 1st wants you to say yes more boldly; Saturn in the 8th reminds you to be exacting around contracts, joint ventures and anything involving trust.

❤️ Love: This is a more introspective romantic day. The 12th-house Moon intensifies dreams, memories and unspoken feelings; Mars there can stir up old hurts that you thought were resolved. Rather than projecting those onto current partners, treat them as information about what your heart now needs. With the Libra planets in your 3rd, love is expressed best through sincere words and attentive listening: a handwritten note, a thoughtful message, a conversation that goes one layer deeper than usual. If partnered, share some of what’s been on your mind without expecting your partner to fix it. If single, notice how you talk about past relationships; that story is quietly shaping what you allow in next.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 8th keeps you learning the difference between support and entanglement in financial matters. It’s a solid day to quietly review loans, shared accounts, insurance and recurring obligations. The 12th-house activation can reveal small drains—subscriptions you never use, emotional bargains that have financial tags attached, or patterns of rescuing others. The Libra 3rd-house focus supports making a few key calls or emails to clarify terms or gather missing information. Jupiter in your 1st suggests that opportunities to improve your situation will grow when you present yourself with calm confidence, not urgency.

🧘 Advice: Treat rest and solitude as intelligent strategy, not as evidence that you’re falling behind. Your best ideas today come when you stop broadcasting and start listening inward.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Some of your most powerful upgrades happen in the quiet decisions you make when no one else is asking you to change.
